headlines.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can t clear it
headlines.summary: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

headlines.title: Main Street Sports sues Comcast, Charter for underpaid licensing fees
headlines.summary: Main Street has been in the process of winding down its portfolio of regional sports networks since the the NHL and NBA seasons ended earlier this year.

headlines.title: A media M&A chill: The Paramount-WBD antitrust challenge may hold up more deals than one
headlines.summary: Paramount's proposed merger with WBD is delayed while an antitrust lawsuit plays out. The holdup could mean a freeze across the media industry.

headlines.title: California AG Rob Bonta cancels Paramount settlement meeting, citing lack of good faith
headlines.summary: California AG Rob Bonta was scheduled to meet with Paramount representatives on Monday, he said, but canceled the meeting.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of huge danger in letting AI replace bankers reasoning skills
headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.

headlines.title: UPS is investing $2 billion in international, healthcare and supply chain businesses
headlines.summary: UPS told CNBC exclusively that the company is investing more than $2 billion into its international, healthcare and supply chain businesses.

headlines.title: After 10 years at United, CEO Scott Kirby is thinking big about the future of his airline from JFK to AI
headlines.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby talked to CNBC in a wide-ranging interview about his proposed airline megadeals, AI and the future of the carrier.

headlines.title: United s next decision: What to do with all those Boeing 737 Max 10 seats it ordered years ago
headlines.summary: United Airlines wanted to put lie-flat premium seats on its Max 10 planes once they were certified, but that has been delayed by years.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo and Citigroup have room to buy a big bank. These 5 regionals fit the bill
headlines.summary: Citigroup and Wells Fargo have room to buy a big regional bank as regulators have opened the door to megadeals. Five regional banks make sense as targets.

headlines.title: Inside Coca-Cola’s secretive innovation labs: How the beverage giant wants to automate dirty soda and refreshers
headlines.summary: From McDonald's to Wendy's, longtime Coke customers have been expanding their beverage offerings to boost their profit margins.

headlines.title: Trump admin taps former JPMorgan Chase exec Matt Zames to advise Social Security agency
headlines.summary: Matt Zames is taking an unpaid position to help his former JPMorgan colleague Frank Bisignano tackle modernization of the SSA, CNBC has learned.

headlines.title: Most Americans aren t anti-vaccine. They re uncertain — and that s a growing public health challenge
headlines.summary: The bigger issue at hand may be that many Americans fall into a large, uncertain middle ground – neither firmly pro-vaccine nor staunchly opposed.

headlines.title: Why some of America s biggest brands are losing ground in China
headlines.summary: Nike, Starbucks and GM have lost ground in China as domestic rivals, geopolitics and changing consumer preferences reshape the market.

headlines.title: New York unseats San Francisco as the top market for tech talent, CBRE reports
headlines.summary: AI-related roles now account for nearly one-third of all tech-talent job listings in the U.S., per the new CBRE report.

headlines.title: California AG tells CNBC that settling Paramount-WBD lawsuit would require robust structural remedies
headlines.summary: California AG Rob Bonta discussed the states' antitrust case to block the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger with CNBC's David Faber.

headlines.title: How wealthy families can prepare for aging parents and avoid a succession crisis
headlines.summary: Relatively few wealthy families are addressing the question of when an aging parent should give up control, advisors and lawyers told CNBC.

headlines.title: Where commercial real estate demand is the highest, according to new data
headlines.summary: The National Association of Realtors has released a new index that uses factors in local economies to indicate future demand.

headlines.title: Walmart stock tumbles 9% after outlook disappoints Wall Street
headlines.summary: Walmart is expected to report its fiscal second-quarter earnings on Thursday, offering a read on the consumer and the K-shaped economy.

headlines.title: Hyundai s new flagship vehicle is a large luxury Genesis EV
headlines.summary: The GV90 features a new design direction for Genesis and expands the Hyundai brand's lineup to seven vehicles in the U.S.

headlines.title: Target says its turnaround is picking up steam, with help from a big tariff refund
headlines.summary: Target posted better-than-expected fiscal second-quarter sales and raised its full-year outlook.

trend_headline: 월마트 충격 속 엇갈린 유통·반독점 리스크
summary: 월마트의 실망스러운 실적 전망에 주가가 급락하며 소비재 및 유통 섹터의 경계감이 확산된 반면, 타겟은 관세 환급 효과 등으로 양호한 실적을 기록하며 엇갈린 흐름을 보였다. 한편 캘리포니아주 등 주 정부 법무장관들의 반독점 소송으로 파라마운트와 워너브라더스 디스커버리(WBD)의 합병이 제동이 걸리며 미디어 M&A 시장에 한파가 불고 있다.
key_points: 월마트(Walmart) 주가 실망스러운 실적 전망 발표 여파로 9% 급락
파라마운트(Paramount)와 WBD의 합병 건이 주 정부 법무장관들의 반독점 소송으로 지연
타겟(Target)은 예상치를 상회한 2분기 실적과 함께 연간 전망을 상향 조정
